alt: A range-sum query on a Fenwick tree. The sum of positions l to r is the prefix sum up to r minus the prefix sum up to l minus 1. Each prefix sum starts at a position, adds that tree entry, then removes the lowest set bit from the position and repeats until it reaches 0. The blocks that the visited entries cover are marked on the elements and fit end to end.

steps.caption: The sum of positions 3 to 7 is query(7) minus query(2): the total of positions 1 to 7, minus the total of positions 1 to 2. query(i) adds tree entries while it walks i down to 0.
query(7): i is 7 (0111). Add tree[7] = 2, the sum of position 7. The total is 2. Remove the lowest set bit, 1, to reach i = 6 (0110).
query(7): i is 6 (0110). Add tree[6] = 6, the sum of positions 5 to 6. The total is 8. Remove the lowest set bit, 2, to reach i = 4 (0100).
query(7): i is 4 (0100). Add tree[4] = 10, the sum of positions 1 to 4. The total is 18. Remove the lowest set bit, 4, to reach i = 0 (0000).
i reached 0, so query(7) stops with 18, the sum of positions 1 to 7.
query(2): i is 2 (0010). Add tree[2] = 5, the sum of positions 1 to 2. The total is 5. Remove the lowest set bit, 2, to reach i = 0 (0000).
i reached 0, so query(2) stops with 5, the sum of positions 1 to 2.
The range sum is 18 - 5 = 13, the total of positions 3 to 7.
The sum of positions 1 to 8 is query(8) minus query(0): the total of positions 1 to 8, minus the total of nothing. query(i) adds tree entries while it walks i down to 0.
query(8): i is 8 (1000). Add tree[8] = 21, the sum of positions 1 to 8. The total is 21. Remove the lowest set bit, 8, to reach i = 0 (0000).
i reached 0, so query(8) stops with 21, the sum of positions 1 to 8.
query(0) starts at 0, so the loop body never runs and the result is 0. Nothing lies before position 1.
The range sum is 21 - 0 = 21, the total of positions 1 to 8.
The sum of position 5 is query(5) minus query(4): the total of positions 1 to 5, minus the total of positions 1 to 4. query(i) adds tree entries while it walks i down to 0.
query(5): i is 5 (0101). Add tree[5] = 5, the sum of position 5. The total is 5. Remove the lowest set bit, 1, to reach i = 4 (0100).
query(5): i is 4 (0100). Add tree[4] = 10, the sum of positions 1 to 4. The total is 15. Remove the lowest set bit, 4, to reach i = 0 (0000).
i reached 0, so query(5) stops with 15, the sum of positions 1 to 5.
query(4): i is 4 (0100). Add tree[4] = 10, the sum of positions 1 to 4. The total is 10. Remove the lowest set bit, 4, to reach i = 0 (0000).
i reached 0, so query(4) stops with 10, the sum of positions 1 to 4.
The range sum is 15 - 10 = 5, the total of position 5.
